name: Easier
title: Easier
clues: Monitor Lizard: "I need to be somewhere sandy without any predators."
Snowy Owl: "I'm nosey, I want to be next door to at least 4 other animals."
Ring-Tailed Lemur: "I'm afraid! I need to have a friend in my enclosure who is not a predator, and I can't have a predator in my enclosure or next door to me."
Brown Bear: "I'm a large predator; I can't be trusted with anybody. I need too much space for the jungle."
Snake-necked Turtle: "I'm an herbivore, I need to be in the jungle."
